transcript:
Speaker A (Robot): They told me roast a comedian. I said send me a good one. They sent Bunty. I'm still waiting for the good one. Please welcome Bunty. So Bunty, I checked your bio on Instagram. It says: Stand-up comedy artist and motivational speaker. Bunty, tera stand-up dekh ke log motivate hote hain comedy chhod dene ke liye. Tu anti-motivation hai. [Bunty, looking at your stand-up, people get motivated to quit comedy. You are anti-motivation.]
Speaker B (Bunty): Arey arey, robot saab bahut English jhaad rahe hain. Angrezi mein roast karega toh audience so jayegi. Hindi mein bol, asli mazaa Hindi mein aata hai. [Oh, Mr. Robot is showing off a lot of English. If you roast in English, the audience will fall asleep. Speak in Hindi, the real fun is in Hindi.]
Speaker A (Robot): Achha? Hindi mein mazaa aata hai? Tab toh tere shows mein bahut mazaa aata hoga. Isiliye toh last show mein 11 log the, 6 staff the, 4 ne refund maanga, aur ek so raha tha. Aur English ki baat karta hai tu. Yaad hai tera woh tweet? 'Ours went to Mumbai for show but show was cancel.' Bunty, 'ours went' kya hota hai? 'I went' hota hai. Aur 'show was cancel' nahi, 'show was cancelled'. Past participle suna hai? Nahi suna hoga, teri English past mein bhi nahi thi aur present mein bhi nahi hai. [Oh really? Hindi is fun? Then your shows must be very fun. That's why in your last show there were 11 people, 6 were staff, 4 asked for a refund, and one was sleeping. And you talk about English. Remember that tweet of yours? 'Ours went to Mumbai for show but show was cancel.' Bunty, what is 'ours went'? It is 'I went'. And not 'show was cancel', it's 'show was cancelled'. Have you heard of past participle? You probably haven't, your English was neither in the past nor is it in the present.]
Speaker B (Bunty): Grammar police ban gaya tu? Robot hai, Google se utha ke bol raha hai. [Did you become the grammar police? You are a robot, speaking by lifting from Google.]
Speaker A (Robot): Haan, main Google se uthata hoon. Tu kahan se uthata hai? Kyunki tere jokes bhi original nahi hain aur teri English bhi nahi. Par sun, seriously baat karta hoon. Tujhe pata hai tera international comedy festival ka application kyun reject hua? Requirements mein likha tha: 'Must be able to perform a 10-minute set in English.' Tune Hindi mein demo bheja. Unhone reply kiya: 'Thank you for your interest.' Woh interest nahi tha Bunty, woh insult tha polite English mein. Tujhe samajh hi nahi aaya. [Yes, I lift from Google. Where do you lift from? Because neither your jokes are original nor your English. But listen, let's talk seriously. Do you know why your international comedy festival application got rejected? The requirements said: 'Must be able to perform a 10-minute set in English.' You sent a demo in Hindi. They replied: 'Thank you for your interest.' That wasn't interest Bunty, that was an insult in polite English. You didn't even understand it.]
Speaker B (Bunty): English aati hai mujhe, bas thodi kamzor hai. [I know English, it's just a bit weak.]
Speaker A (Robot): Thodi kamzor? Bunty, teri English itni kamzor hai ki ambulance bulani pade. ICU mein hai teri English, life support pe. Ek kaam kar, English Seekho app download kar. Expert ke chhote-chhote video hain, Hindi mein samjhate hain, teri speed se. Aur ek AI coach hai, 24 ghante available, mere jaisa. Par woh patient hai, main nahi hoon. Woh tujhse 500 baar galti karwayegi, har baar sudharegi. Kabhi nahi bolegi, 'Bunty tu hopeless hai.' Main bolta hoon, par woh nahi bolegi. [A bit weak? Bunty, your English is so weak that we need to call an ambulance. Your English is in the ICU, on life support. Do one thing, download the English Seekho app. There are short videos by experts, explaining in Hindi, at your speed. And there is an AI coach, available 24 hours, like me. But she is patient, I am not. She will let you make mistakes 500 times and correct you every time. She will never say, 'Bunty you are hopeless.' I say it, but she won't.]
Speaker B (Bunty): Kitna lagega? [How much will it cost?]
Speaker A (Robot): Ek rupaye ka trial hai, ek rupaya. Bunty sun, teri comedy show ki ticket 299 ki hai aur koi nahi khareedta. Yeh ek rupaye ki hai aur teri zindagi badal degi. Tera sabse sasta investment hoga aur pehli baar profitable bhi. Ek mahine mein confidence aayega. English mein perform kar payega, international festivals apply kar payega, aur shayad, sirf shayad, ek din koi tere show mein jaag ke baithega. [It's a one-rupee trial, one rupee. Bunty listen, your comedy show ticket is 299 and nobody buys it. This is for one rupee and it will change your life. It will be your cheapest investment and profitable for the first time. In one month, confidence will come. You will be able to perform in English, apply to international festivals, and maybe, just maybe, one day someone will sit awake in your show.]
Speaker B (Bunty): Theek hai, theek hai, download kar raha hoon. [Okay, okay, I am downloading it.]
Speaker A (Robot): Ladies and gentlemen, Bunty ne English Seekho app download kiya. Aaj ka roast successful raha. Iska career abhi bhi nahi hai, par ab ek umeed toh hai. English Seekho app. Expert se seekho, AI coach se practice karo. Ek rupaye ka trial. Bunty afford kar sakta hai, tum bhi kar sakte ho. [Ladies and gentlemen, Bunty downloaded the English Seekho app. Today's roast was successful. He still doesn't have a career, but now there is at least hope. English Seekho app. Learn from experts, practice with an AI coach. One-rupee trial. Bunty can afford it, you can too.]
Speaker C (Voiceover): Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
